title: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Iloilo Leg 3 Review: 32K in the City of Love
seo_title: Sante Barley Run Iloilo Leg 3 2026 Review | Philippines Race
meta_description: Sante Barley Trilogy Run Asia 2026 Iloilo Leg 3: August 23. 32K, 21K, 10K, 5K from Runrio.
dek: Set for 23 August 2026 in Iloilo City, this Runrio-produced Sante Barley series leg features the rare 32K distance in the 'City of Love.'
verdict: The Sante Barley Trilogy Run Iloilo Leg 3 brings the rare 32K distance to Iloilo City — one of the Philippines' most charming destinations with its heritage houses, river esplanade, and exceptional food scene. Produced by Runrio, it also offers standard 21K, 10K, and 5K distances. Iloilo's flat terrain makes for a fast course. August in Iloilo is the wet season. A distinctive Runrio-produced Visayas series leg with the unusual 32K option.
